'''Tel Kar''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Wyld Woods}}. Talking with him fully grants an {{Item|Enigma Soul}}.

}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Why are you trapped?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Because I made the &cmistake &fof entering through a &5breach&f!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: You see, there is a &5breach &fnear the portal you entered, in your world.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: As a dwarf, I spend considerable time exploring &3caves &fand &bmountains&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: And I stepped into &5it &fby &caccident&f!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Anyway...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Any &5breach &fhas an extremely large impact on &dcausality&f. This is why everything is so strange.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Until that &5breach &fis &a&otamed&r, anything that steps through it becomes a paradox and remains &cTRAPPED&f.
&eSelect an option: &a[How do we tame it?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[How do we tame it?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I'm not certain, but I have a theory.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I think you'll find the answer to that question at the top of the &bmountain&f, right here in the &dRift&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: However, it won't be easy getting all the way up there.
&eSelect an option: &a[Why?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Why?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Uh...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: How do I explain...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: You know about the three primary &ddimensions&f, right?
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Up-down.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Left-right.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Forward-backward.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Right?
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: They're also known as x, y and z.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Well...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Well, what if I told you this &dplace&f has &lFIVE &fdimensions?
&eSelect an option: &a[Ok. What is the 4th one?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Ok. What is the 4th one?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: It's usually recognized that &aTIME &fis the 4th dimension.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: But &atime &fdoes not flow in the &dRift&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: You can use &atime &faround &dhere &fjust as well as you can move in 3D in your world, as if you can interact with  the space-time continuum itself.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: It's a &orelatively &csuperhot &rconcept in physics.
&eSelect an option: &a[I'm following. What is the 5th dimension?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[I'm following. What is the 5th dimension?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: It is the only constant of &aSkyBlock&f...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: &eRandomness&f!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Which is more accurately defined as &dpossibilities&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: &oMost &rpeople and things have a reflection in other universes.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Infinite reflections, one for each possibility.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: In your world, randomness is pre-defined.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Only affected by powers like &bMagic Find&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: But here?
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Anything is possible.
&eSelect an option: &a[Sure, but what about the mountain?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Sure, but what about the mountain?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I was just about to explain!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: The closer you get to the &btop of the mountain&f, the stronger the &o&ddistortion &rgets.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Basically, the &bmountain &fmight seem close to you in three dimensions...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: But in reality, &bit &fis &overy very &rfar away in five dimensions!
&eSelect an option: &a[How do I reach it then?]
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: No one knows for sure.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: But as you may have noticed, as you experience the &dRift&f, you gain control over more and more &atime&f.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: So if you interact with everything in &dhere&f, it might lead you to the &bmountain&f!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Do you have anymore questions?
&eSelect an option: &a[Yes. Do you have a soul for me?]}}
|-
| class="ct" | Selecting {{Rmt|&a[Yes. Do you have a soul for me?]}}
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: What a &ocoincidence&r!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I &ado&f!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: See how this &auniverse &fis filled with &erandomness&f?
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Take it!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I loved talking with you!
}}
|-
| class="ct" | After claiming [[Enigma Soul]]
|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: I would love talking more with you, but I'm not sure I have the time.
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: It's a joke... I have infinite time!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: In fact I'm the exact opposite of you...
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Time is the only thing I have!
&e[NPC] Tel Kar&f: Anyway, see you around.}}

== Trivia ==
*'''Tel Kar'''<nowiki />'s dialogue effectively confirms, that those who enter [[Rift Dimension]] through [[The Breach]] rather than through [[Wizard Portal]] are unable to ever leave.
*'''Tel Kar''' is one of a few NPCs who are not originally from [[Rift Dimension]], alongside {{NPCSprite|Dr. Emmett}}, {{NPCSprite|Barry}}, {{NPCSprite|Alatar}} and {{NPCSprite|Julian}}.
